partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Compact-process two-driver connector inhibition
results.hypothesis: A physical connector is more mechanistically coherent when it and at least two top-ranked causal drivers participate in the same compact biological process.
results.body: R285 plus connector and two causal drivers share one process with at most 100 gene members
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines a nonlinear physical star with independent functional convergence in one compact process.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; same-process identity, process degree, driver cardinality, rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver:Gene)

MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process:BiologicalProcess)
      <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)

MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, target, object, process, collect(DISTINCT driver) AS drivers
WHERE size(drivers) >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
